notes: Placed together with jiangsu-wuxi and jiangsu-changzhou (Lake Tai basin). Shape decision: Suzhou (old city, Industrial Park, Tiger Hill, Hanshan, Mudu) is one destination; the water towns Zhouzhuang (Kunshan), Tongli (Wujiang) and Luzhi (Wuzhong) sit 28-40 km east/south-east and are filed by Wikivoyage outside the Suzhou city article, so they form the named cluster 'Jiangnan Water Towns' (7 kept spots). Kunshan (3), Changshu (3) and Taicang (2) are below the four-spot bar and stand alone; so does Dongting Mountain on Lake Tai. Lake Tai is placed once, from the Wuxi file. Town/attraction pairs kept because the skeptic kept both and each town is itself a canal-town draw (Zhouzhuang/Shen's Residence, Tongli/Retreat and Reflection Garden, Luzhi/Baosheng Temple); Suzhou Industrial Park and Jinji Lake are a district beside its lake attraction, flagged for Pipeline C to keep or fold. Spots marked destination_provisional have no source coordinates; the destination is chosen from the named place and must be re-checked once resolve-pin.py gives a pin. Reviews (not placed) are in review_list_not_placed.
